game.name: Terraria
game.rules:
All runs are RTA (Real Time Attack) runs.

Timing starts upon the first frame of entering the first world. Timing ends upon the chatlog on the bottom left stating that the appropriate last boss/event is defeated. If an item is to be acquired, timing ends the instant the item is in the player's possession.

Runs are expected to uphold a standard of quality. See: [https://pastebin.com/5dNznggw](https://pastebin.com/5dNznggw)

- The chat log, on the bottom left, will not be covered. This includes transparent applications.
- Runs in the top 20% will include **in-game audio and music**
- Raw (unedited) footage of the run is required.

## Submission Rules

- All submission information must be accurate, including Players, Final Time, Game Version, and Run Date. Seeded runs will include full world seed(s) within the run description.
- Glitchless runs belong under NMA (No Major Abuses), see Category Rules. Reposting 1.4 NMA (non-journey) runs to the 1.4 Glitched category is NOT allowed.
- If your run has been previously verified and is no longer viewable, it is liable to be removed. Note that Twitch VODs expire after a certain amount of time, unless they are highlighted.

## Platform Rules

- Any modern platform that has a patch equivalent to 1.3.5.3 or above is allowed. These must be submitted with the equivalent version variable. PC versions of 1.3.0.1+ are allowed.
- For Windows/Linux ONLY, seeded runs may use worlds generated on either platform, as long as the same game version was used. Specify in the run description if you have done so.

## Gameplay Rules

- Texture Pack Rules: Texture packs are allowed if they clearly and uncontroversially provide no advantage over the default texture pack (exemption: Transparent UI texture packs). You must provide a download link for the texture pack you use, if asked for.

### Random Seed:

- Show both the character creation and world generation at the start of your video. 
- The world seed must be fully shown in the video before entering the world. Note that certain languages tend to cut off part of the seed during world creation in 1.4.

### Set Seed:

- Seeded runs do not require world generation. You may copy-paste fresh worlds between runs. 
- Worlds must be generated on the same version you are running. (i.e. you cannot generate a world on 1.4.1, then use it on 1.4.4) (see Platform rules for exception)
- Character creation is still required.
- For runs that use multiple worlds, the submission must use the difficulty of the world with the lowest difficulty used.

### Restrictions:

- **As of July 28 2023** - In-game frame rate must be capped to 60 FPS. To prevent the game from rendering more than 60 frames for high refresh rate displays, set "Frame Skip" to Subtle or On.
- Third-party tools that provide an advantage (for example map viewers, world editors) will not be tolerated, **even for seeded runs.**
- Macros are only allowed for resets and player/world generation.
- Using the snapshot feature of camera mode is banned.
- Halloween or Christmas content **cannot be used** if triggered by the system clock. Vanity items are okay.
- You may not use "easter egg" seeds (example: '05162020' , 'not the bees').
- Shift + F9 flickering is banned (allows you to see in the dark).
- Item carry-over glitch is banned.

relatedGames.name: Terraria Category Extensions
relatedGames.rules:
**Main Rules**

- Show both the creation of the character and the generation of the world at the start of your video.
- Include in your submission: World Seed(s), size, difficulty and evil.
To enable the world seed feature, see this guide: https://www.speedrun.com/terraria/guide/us9m0
- The chat log, on the bottom left, should not have anything covering it. This includes transparent applications.
- An external timer is encouraged, otherwise time with the video - timing method is RTA
- Raw (unedited) footage of the run is required. Segmented runs are not allowed; see All Achievements rules for the one exception.
- Using macros is only allowed for world generation
- Using Shift + F9 flickering is not allowed (allows you to see in the dark)
- Runs in the top 20% must include **in-game audio and music**
- **Starting July 28th** - The highest frame rate allowed is 60. To prevent the game from rendering more than 60 frames for high refresh rate displays, set "Frame Skip" to Subtle or On.

**Other**

- [1.3] Random seed runs must mouse over the seed display immediately after generation.
- [1.4] Easter egg seeds (For the worthy, not the bees etc.) are not allowed
- Runs are expected to uphold a standard of quality (i.e. no intentional "slowrun" submissions, challenge runs or playthroughs which do not primarily take speed into account when completing the goal, at least 20fps recording, no cropping of game display, video quality must be high enough to read in-game text, etc.).

- You may switch from a normal world to an expert world or visa-versa. Any run that uses a normal world can only be submitted in the normal category, regardless of where bosses are defeated.
- Using third-party tools that provide an advantage (for example map viewers, world editors) is not allowed
- The usage of cursor storage to carry items onto new characters is forbidden

All runs are RTA (Real Time Attack) runs. Timing starts upon gaining control of a new character in a new world.

categories.rules: Timing of this category stops when Moon Lord's death message appears in the chat log.

categories.name: All Bosses
categories.rules:
All Bosses
-----------------

For event bosses, go to Category Extensions.

- Versions 1.4.3 and newer require killing Deerclops. Older versions are allowed in the "Any Order" subcategory.

- Bosses to defeat: King Slime, Eye of Cthulhu, Eater of Worlds **OR** Brain of Cthulhu, Queen Bee, Skeletron, Wall of Flesh, Queen Slime, The Twins, The Destroyer, Skeletron Prime, Plantera, Golem, Duke Fishron, Empress of Light, Lunatic Cultist, Moon Lord. 

Timing of this category stops when the last boss's death message appears in the chat log.

categories.name: 1 Player
categories.rules:
**View Game Rules**

Only one player may ever enter the world.

categories.name: Co-op
categories.rules:
Only host point of view is required.
Two characters must be used, from separate players. Even if one remains idle through-out.

categories.name: All Pre-Hardmode Bosses
categories.rules:
Timing of this category stops when the last bosses' death message appears in the chat log.

- Versions 1.4.3 and newer Require killing Deerclops. Older versions are allowed.

- Bosses to defeat: King Slime, Eye of Cthulhu, Eater of Worlds **OR** Brain of Cthulhu, Queen Bee, Skeletron, Wall of Flesh. 

You may defeat them in any order.

categories.name: Night's Edge
categories.rules: Timing of this category stops the instant the item is the possession of the player.

categories.name: Co-op
categories.rules:
Co-op Speedruns
------
- Submit runs with 2 or more players in this category.
- Only the host POV is required.
 - If you can include multiple points of view, put the links in run description.
 - For Night's Edge, timing ends once either it is crafted, or shown on screen by the other player. (This means that the first person to join the world should be the one to craft the weapon, and submit with their POV. Otherwise you may end up with an inaccurate final time. If it's never seen, then we cannot verify your run.)

values.rules:
**NMA - No Major Abuses**
-----

The following glitches and/or strategies are not permitted in categories marked with NMA:
- Use of multiple worlds or characters
- Renaming your world or character during the run
- Hoiking (includes hoiking enemies, but Does Not include deliberate use of hook to move through 1-block-wide vertical tunnels, aka hook digging)
- Using craftable beehives for any means
- Obtaining items through illegitimate/unintended means (e.g. Duping, transmutation glitch, OOA mana storing)
- Invincibility / Premeditated Iframe setups (e.g. spikes, slime statues)
- Using ALT F4 to rollback progress in any way
- Mob cap exploitation (the 200 entity limit)
- Despawning boss segments (except for Skeletron and Plantera)
- Any other strategy/glitch banned in Game Rules

All Bosses Set Order
-----------

- Bosses must be defeated in this order: King Slime, Eye of Cthulhu, Brain of Cthulhu **OR** Eater of Worlds, Queen Bee, Skeletron, Deerclops, Wall of Flesh, Queen Slime, 3 Mechanical bosses in any order, Plantera, Golem, Duke Fishron, Empress of Light, Lunatic Cultist, Moon Lord.

----------

- Bosses may be killed in any order
- Timing ends when the last pre-hardmode boss is killed.
- Bosses to defeat: King Slime, Eye of Cthulhu, Eater of Worlds **OR** Brain of Cthulhu, Queen Bee, Skeletron, Deerclops*, Wall of Flesh.
- Versions 1.4.3 and newer Require killing Deerclops. Older versions are allowed.

values.name: All Pre-Hardmode Bosses Set Order
values.rules:

-----------

- Bosses must be defeated in this order: King Slime, Eye of Cthulhu, Brain of Cthulhu **OR** Eater of Worlds, Queen Bee, Skeletron, Deerclops, Wall of Flesh.
- You are allowed to kill already defeated bosses later in the run, but killing a boss earlier than intended and then doing the order will invalidate your run (i.e.: You may kill Eye of Cthulhu as many times as you want after the initial set order kill, but you cannot kill Wall of Flesh and then start killing the bosses in the set order).

- For runs on 1.3, the order is the same but without Deerclops.
